title: Colibri source repository and INT4 model were publicly linked
summary: On 2026-07-12, a Colibri GitHub repository and a Hugging Face page for a GLM-5.2 Colibri INT4 model were linked together. This is dated evidence that the project's source code and a related quantized model artifact were presented as public resources. The recorded link was not provided, so its exact release status, authorship, and functionality cannot be confirmed from the links alone.
